changes.comment: Move the built-in Feishu channel implementation into the publishable @excitedjs/feishu-channel package and depend on it by default (issue #209 slice 5). channel/feishu/ becomes a thin core-owned adapter that resolves the host contracts the package must not reconstruct (bot secret/app id from the dispatcher row+config, the per-dispatcher state dir for access.json/chat-bots.json, the attachment cache dir) and constructs the package session; the Feishu MCP server descriptor and admin-method routing for Feishu actions stay in core, and bot/feishu-mcp-surface become re-export shims so existing import paths are stable. Routing, binding state, authorization, and Team lifecycle stay core-owned. The builtin:feishu alias and current operator/runtime behavior are unchanged; no operator action required on upgrade.
